name: Love-Colored Memories
summary:
Love-Colored Memories is a Touhou Project dating sim where Marisa suddenly realizes she's completely forgotten about Valentine's Day!

With White Day fast approaching, she'll have just a few weeks to train her stats, manage her daily schedule, and win the hearts of Gensokyo's unforgettable girls before time runs out.

Every choice matters as you balance self-improvement, explore familiar locations, and go on perfect dates, leading to unique romantic routes and multiple endings.

Whether your love story blossoms or crashes and burns, one thing's for sure: White Day waits for no witch!

This game was made in three weeks for Touhou Pride Game Jam 8!
